method.source_selection: reuse FrozenDevTrainingSelector and the same study-level assignment and exact 16-project development gate from RealDevArtifactMaskPairV1; open only selected development .dig projects and their referenced source images
method.plot_region: ProductionAxisGeometryAdapter detected plot polygon using the local OpenCV CPU path
method.scan: count foreground centers inside detected plot polygon with two opposing line pairs; line runs use gray<=196 and cap at 64; pair must each have summed span>13
method.contrast: fixed diagnostic comparison of min-arm=5 (production constant) against min-arm=4; no production threshold or code is changed
method.deduplication: apply the provider's strength-descending NMS radius 6 independently to each fixed min-arm scan
method.annotation_use: Engauge point centers are evaluation-only; count a center as covered when it lies inside the provider's 5x5 square mask (Chebyshev radius 2), without treating that overlap as verified marker/artifact truth
method.aggregation: aggregate only across images; no text, paths, source identifiers, coordinates, pixels, or per-project counts in output

interpretation_limits: This is a raster structure census, not a production mask run or candidate evaluation. The first V1 report used Euclidean point proximity and is retained as non-authoritative for point-mask overlap; V2 uses the exact 5x5 square mask footprint.
It does not apply production OCR masks, axis/tick geometry seed masks, or marker-like conflict rejection.
Engauge point centers are incomplete point labels; they do not label all marker pixels or negative structures.
Proposals near point centers are only spatial associations, not verified ticks, markers, or false positives.
This previously exposed development sample cannot establish sealed acceptance or generalization.
